source_text: From 2020 to 2025, global FGM cases rose 15% to over 230 million, partly fueled by medicalized forms in urbanizing areas, underscoring how professional involvement legitimizes the practice rather than eroding it, as confirmed by WHO and UNICEF analyses rejecting "safer" variants. [2]
